about: A sixteenth round of the tests Trillion-X/trillion PR #243 (4ffa1dc4a2) deleted with no home and no port-backlog row (its backlog listed only source and data), carried byte for byte from 1e886c3f68 (the parent of 7fd8838475, which moved 1,028 of the files they import into this repository; each test there has the same bytes as at the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire, and its imports still name a file) into the Workshop tool that now holds the code each one tests. Each group is one tool and the tests whose subject it holds; every file they import is home in this repository, byte for byte or as a copy an earlier lane adapted or renamed (adapted_homes names each, with how it was found), so only the tests and their test help move; each test runs against the adapted copy, and only a test with no failure by name that passes at the tag stays. the first rounds are trillion-pr243-tests-to-workshop.json, -2, -3 to -15; these are the tests the old-trillion sweep lanes (trillion-workshop #203, #204, #219 to #221) gave every file a home; docs/pr243-deleted-tests.json lists every such test and where it went. Test help a test reads by its address (a fixture page) is named as an owner of its group, since the import closure does not follow a path read.
